title: STREAM Trial - Statins in Multimorbid Older Adults Without Cardiovascular Disease

sections.abstract: Statins are among the most widely used drugs. While they were found to be effective for primary and secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in middle-aged subjects, their benefits for primary prevention in older adults (aged ≥70 years) without CVD are uncertain, particularly for those with multimorbidity. The aim of this randomized controlled trial (RCT) is to provide guidance on the benefits and risks of statin deprescribing in multimorbid older adults.
